matching: Reuse exactly one existing row by trimmed case-insensitive Approver_Email. Stop on multiple matches. Never change an existing login or permission fields.

create_only_when_no_match.permissions: Retain all existing false defaults; do not assign a profile, owner, role or permission grant.

required_existing_person.name: Samuel Spears

provenance.method: Authenticated native report read-only inspection by the parent agent

required_existing_person.rule: Production: reuse this exact confirmed existing Sam record without changing its login or permissions. Resolve record IDs in each environment separately; never copy a Production record ID into Development lookups.

development_seed.rule: Development began with demo users and now has separately created notification contacts recorded in setup-verification.json. Reuse exactly one matching email if present; otherwise explicitly create a notification-only Sam contact with existing false permission defaults. Do not create or map a Creator account.

settings.record: Require exactly one Settings record; never create a second singleton.
settings.write: Explicit one-time setup only. Preserve pre-existing choices unless the user requested replacing them. Loading Settings never seeds or rewrites these lists.

territories: Do not infer Construction PM from VP, Dev Mgr, name or department. Assignment is explicit on each Territory.
production_rollout: The read-only Sam inspection is not a Production mutation or release. Creation of the three provided Production contacts and recipient-list setup are deferred until the Creator publication step; Production's existing Sam record remains unchanged.
